## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: safe driving tips: visual search, speed, stopping distance, space management and communicating
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The perception time, reaction time and braking distance figures are the manual's own averages with no cited study, so they are reported as the manual states them [A05].
The flood depth figures for six inches and two feet of water are the manual's general statements for most vehicles, not limits for any particular vehicle [A04].
Physical page 99 ends with an empty bullet and a picture area; no fact is drawn from it [A07].
The list of times to signal before slowing ends at the bottom of physical page 102; any items that continue on the next page belong to the next section and are not taught here [A10].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
